correctness.rationale: The exact duad-syntheme graph and synchronous threshold-two update are unambiguous. Two separately written, executed standard-library programs enumerate all 32,768 shore inputs, prove by finite exhaustive checks P^3=P^2 and Q^3=Q^2, and reproduce all 2386 phase labels and nine paired fiber types. The algebraic product argument proves every basin and the sharp four-update limit over all 2^30 states; both programs verify orbit populations, total basin mass and entrance layers. A direct orbit witness (point mask 106, line mask 0) attains the cutoff. No incomplete search is used as a proof.

value.rationale: The unique cubic girth-eight cage is a canonical symmetric generalized-quadrangle incidence graph, giving this complete invariant an independently motivated natural domain. The eight fixed-basin sizes and 36 two-cycle basin sizes are derived from a compact nine-type exact paired-fiber table. The 240 mismatched paired fibers (22,38)/(38,22), despite graph self-duality, distinguish attractor phase labels from their initial-state attraction and are not a renaming or immediate corollary of generic period-two theory. The full census and sharp clock can benchmark threshold dynamics beyond the seven-point Fano case.
